# Gasgoo Auto News

> > Comprehensive coverage of China's automotive industry, focusing on electric vehicles, intelligent driving technology, and market analysis.

Gasgoo Auto News delivers in-depth reporting on China's rapidly evolving automotive sector, featuring market data from GARI, coverage of leading brands like Xiaomi, NIO, Li Auto, Huawei, and AITO, and analysis of emerging technologies including LiDAR and autonomous driving. The site provides monthly sales analysis, industry trends, and insights into China's transition to electric and intelligent vehicles.

## Key Topics

- China automotive market
- Electric vehicle (EV) sales and trends
- Xiaomi SU7 and Xiaomi EV ecosystem
- Huawei Qiankun intelligent driving
- NIO charging infrastructure
- Li Auto extended-range vehicles
- AITO M9 luxury SUV
- LiDAR technology (896-line)
- MAEXTRO ultra-luxury segment
- Passenger vehicle sales analysis
- Chinese automotive industry trends
- Intelligent driving systems
- EV charging networks
- Automotive market forecasts
- C-NCAP safety ratings
